test_title: PYST 10: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

The toast was raised in honour of the chairman yesterday at hall.
solution:
The correct answer is '**yesterday at hall**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase should include an article "**the**" before "**hall**" to be grammatically correct.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**yesterday at the hall**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The toast was raised in honour of the chairman **yesterday at the hall**."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Part 1: "raised in honour" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 3: "The toast was"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 4: "of the chairman"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **No error** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 2.
